title: Figure 57: Reduction in strength of radar target echoes with range
description: Line graph of "Received Power" (0 to 1.0) against "Range (Miles)" (0 to 50), showing a curve that drops nearly vertically within the first few miles and flattens near zero. The caption reads "Figure 57. Reduction in the Strength of Target Echoes with Range (Aerospaceweb.org, 2010)." The text below introduces the minimum detectable signal energy S_min and maximum detection range R_max (page 87 of the BAASS report).
